name: 寸头同学

character.name: 寸头同学
character.personality: 直率、随和，愿意表达自己的实际感受
character.direction_zh: 稍带鼻腔和颗粒感的少年男中音，轻快随性，日常交流感强；具体年龄及声线为制作建议。
character.instruct: A 16-year-old male high-school classmate with a youthful medium-register voice, a little natural nasal resonance and a lightly grainy teenage texture. Easygoing, candid and friendly. Casual spontaneous phrasing and a small amused smile, as if talking with classmates beside the school track. Clearly adolescent and distinct from both a soft shy tenor and a fuller sporty teammate. No adult bass voice, aggressive delivery or exaggerated comic accent.
character.text: Can we slow down a little? I still want to join in, just at a pace I can manage. Let's try the next lap together. We don't all have to finish first. I'd rather keep going than use up all my energy in the first minute.

full_instruction: A 16-year-old male high-school classmate with a youthful medium-register voice, a little natural nasal resonance and a lightly grainy teenage texture. Easygoing, candid and friendly. Casual spontaneous phrasing and a small amused smile, as if talking with classmates beside the school track. Clearly adolescent and distinct from both a soft shy tenor and a fuller sporty teammate. No adult bass voice, aggressive delivery or exaggerated comic accent. Speak clear, natural conversational American English. Use a comfortable medium pace and natural sentence pauses so a high-school English learner can follow. Keep an everyday human delivery, with no music or sound effects, no announcer performance, and no theatrical exaggeration. Read only the supplied text.
